topic: Review of impression data structure and integration
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered the receipt of updated files from a third party (Remboll). The primary data transfer method is confirmed to be via API, using test data initially. A separate file containing road links was reviewed and deemed acceptable; integration discussions for this link will happen with 'Evgen' upon his return.

A key discussion point involved reviewing a sample dataset of impressions, which included full panel traffic for one day broken down by demographic categories. The structure of this test data was reviewed and confirmed to be understandable and convertible into the internal system format.
decisions: The primary method for transferring parket files is via API.
Integration discussions regarding road links will wait until 'Evgen' returns.
